title: One evaluator step
statement: For a configuration with phase $\phi$, computed Boolean values $v$, marked cells $M$, and head position $j$, and an input symbol that may be absent, first apply the evaluator's transition rule to $\phi$, the symbol, the value at position $j$ if present, and the mark-tape lookup at $j$. Then apply the resulting action to the configuration using the abstract update rule; the result is either a new configuration or an output Boolean.
